question: Who was awarded the Vigyan Ratna in 2024 for his contributions in the field of Biological Sciences?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prof. Govindarajan Padmanabhan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Prof. Govindarajan Padmanabhan** was honored with the inaugural **Vigyan Ratna** award in **2024** for his monumental contributions to the field of **Biological Sciences**.
 
• The **Vigyan Ratna** is the highest recognition in the newly instituted **Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar** series, awarded for **lifetime achievements** and contributions in any field of science and technology.
 
• **Prof. Padmanabhan** is a distinguished **biochemist** and a former Director of the **Indian Institute of Science (IISc)**, **Bengaluru**, where he has spent decades advancing research in **molecular biology**.
